Hi Alice — quick technical note to clarify the differences and what we can provide out-of-the-box versus what requires Private deployment. High-level bullets to help your security team triage: 

1) Redwood Dedicated (recommended first step for many customers)- What you get: single-tenant GPU pool dedicated to your account, options for per-tenant VPC peering, support for customer-managed KMS (CMK) for encryption-at-rest, audit logs with 1:1 request IDs, and the ability to restrict egress to specific IPs or peered VPC endpoints.- Limitations: control plane remains in Redwood-managed environment (we offer strict RBAC and encrypted control plane traffic). If your compliance requires the control plane to be inside your VPC or air-gapped, you'll need Private.

2) Private VPC / On-prem deployment- What you get: control plane and inference runtime installed in your VPC or on-prem environment (we can support both). Full network isolation, no outbound traffic except what you explicitly allow, and we can sign an addendum guaranteeing no cross-account access. Typically required when legal requires no third-party control-plane access.- Tradeoffs: longer lead time (2–6 weeks for VPC automation, 6–10 weeks for on-prem depending on infra), and an engineering professional services scope for initial setup and maintenance.

Additional notes:
- Audit logs: both modes provide detailed logs; Dedicated stores logs in a customer-designated S3 bucket if requested (we can configure lifecycle/retention). Private gives you full control of the logging pipeline.
- KMS: CMK support for Dedicated means you control key rotation. For Private, keys never leave your KMS.
- Co-tenancy: Dedicated pools are physically isolated at the instance level; we do not colocate multiple customer workloads on the same GPU instance. We can provide an architecture statement for procurement.

I attached a lightweight VPC checklist that our infra team uses during onboarding. If you confirm Dedicated is acceptable from a governance perspective, we can produce an initial cost sheet for a 2-week POC (including GPU hours and egress estimates). If Private is required, we’ll scope a SOW and provide a phased timeline.

Next technical step (suggested)- Security walk-through (30–45 min) with your infra team and Shalini to review the checklist in detail and validate the KMS/audit approach.
